The word च 'and' etc. are called निपात or Particles, when they do not signify susbtances.

Terms: निपात-संज्ञा
A finite verb, not preceded by a गति , retains its accent before the particles च (1. वा 2. ह 3. अह and 4. एव -- न चवाहाहैवयुक्ते
When च (1. वा 2. ह 3. अह and 4. एव -- न चवाहाहैवयुक्ते

) are elided the first verb optionally retains its accent.

Terms: Accent
